nodes.name: skill_sync.rs
nodes.summary: Syncs Orgii project skills and coding conventions into each CLI agent's expected rule/skill file locations (e.g. CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules, AGENTS.md) within a workspace.

nodes.name: sync_skills_for_agent
nodes.summary: Writes the enabled project skills into the rule files expected by a given CLI agent within the workspace.

nodes.name: cleanup_synced_skill_files
nodes.summary: Deletes previously synced skill/rule files at the given paths.

nodes.name: rule_targets_for_agent
nodes.summary: Determines which rule file paths a given CLI agent reads within a workspace.

nodes.name: build_skills_prompt_injection
nodes.summary: Builds the prompt-injection text block listing enabled skills for a workspace.

nodes.name: build_skills_content
nodes.summary: Builds the full skills content/documentation to write into an agent's rule file.

nodes.name: write_rule_file
nodes.summary: Writes formatted rule content to a target file path.

nodes.name: sync_conventions_for_agent
nodes.summary: Writes the project's coding conventions into the convention files expected by a given CLI agent.

nodes.name: convention_targets_for_agent
nodes.summary: Determines which convention file paths a given CLI agent reads within a workspace.

nodes.name: tui_bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Bridges native TUI (terminal UI) session state/status events into Orgii's session live-status tracking, translating TUI agent bindings into UI status updates.

nodes.name: status_for_state
nodes.summary: Maps a TUI application state into a display status string.

nodes.name: native_id_for_binding
nodes.summary: Resolves the native process/session id bound to a TUI event for a given agent.

nodes.name: on_live_status_event
nodes.summary: Handles an incoming live-status event from a TUI session and updates its tracked state.

nodes.name: apply_event
nodes.summary: Applies a TUI event to update Orgii's live status tracking for the corresponding session.

nodes.name: release_tui_session
nodes.summary: Releases/cleans up tracked state for a TUI session once it ends.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines core CLI session enums SessionStatus (lifecycle state) and SessionRunner (execution transport), with parsing and display trait implementations.

nodes.name: SessionStatus
nodes.summary: Enum representing a CLI session's lifecycle status (Pending, Running, Idle, Completed, Failed, Cancelled) with helpers to check terminal/resumable state.

nodes.name: SessionRunner
nodes.summary: Enum representing which runtime executes a CLI session: Local process or Tui (terminal UI).

nodes.name: agent_core_bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Adapter layer bridging the generic agent-core event push/notify/tool-call API onto Orgii's per-session event store, handling tool-call completion, streaming placeholders, plan-revision finalization, and stranded-event repair.

nodes.name: complete_tool_call_by_call_id_adapter
nodes.summary: Marks a tool call identified by call_id as complete/failed in the session's event store and updates its result.

nodes.name: replace_streaming_event_adapter
nodes.summary: Replaces a streaming placeholder event with its finalized event content in the session's event store.

nodes.name: unpin_session_adapter
nodes.summary: Unpins a session in the event store so it becomes eligible for eviction.

nodes.name: finalize_plan_revision_events_adapter
nodes.summary: Finalizes events tied to a plan revision, resolving the revision's outcome in the session's event store.

nodes.name: persist_events_async_adapter
nodes.summary: Asynchronously persists a batch of events for a session with retry, without blocking the caller.

nodes.name: persist_user_message_event_adapter
nodes.summary: Persists a user-authored message event (with optional images and turn intent) into the session's event store.

nodes.name: repair_stranded_plan_events
nodes.summary: Repairs plan-mode events left in an inconsistent state (e.g. orphaned from a crashed session) across the event store.

nodes.name: remove_events_by_ids_adapter
nodes.summary: Removes a set of events by id from a session's event store.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers this module's adapter functions as the concrete implementation used by the generic agent-core event pipeline.

nodes.name: analytics.rs
nodes.summary: Computes analytics (tool usage, file changes, conversation stats, token usage, timeline buckets, error rates) for a single session or aggregated across multiple sessions from their event streams.

nodes.name: compute_session_analytics
nodes.summary: Computes the full SessionAnalytics summary (tool usage, file changes, conversation stats, tokens, timeline, errors) for a single session's events.

nodes.name: compute_multi_session_analytics
nodes.summary: Aggregates SessionAnalytics across multiple sessions into a MultiSessionSummary.

nodes.name: empty_analytics
nodes.summary: Returns an empty/zeroed SessionAnalytics value for sessions with no events.

nodes.name: parse_iso_ms
nodes.summary: Parses an ISO-8601 timestamp string into milliseconds since epoch.

nodes.name: days_from_civil
nodes.summary: Converts a calendar year/month/day into a day count since epoch (civil calendar algorithm).

nodes.name: categorize_file_operation
nodes.summary: Categorizes a tool function name into a file-operation type (read/write/edit/etc.) for analytics grouping.

nodes.name: extract_token_info
nodes.summary: Extracts input/output token counts and model name from an event for token-usage analytics.

nodes.name: compute_timeline_buckets
nodes.summary: Buckets events into fixed time intervals to build a timeline chart of activity.

nodes.name: ms_to_iso
nodes.summary: Converts a millisecond epoch timestamp into an ISO-8601 string.

nodes.name: civil_from_days
nodes.summary: Converts a day count since epoch back into a calendar year/month/day (inverse of days_from_civil).

nodes.name: SessionAnalytics
nodes.summary: Top-level analytics summary for a session: event counts, duration, tool usage, file changes, conversation stats, token stats, timeline buckets and error stats.

nodes.name: ToolUsageEntry
nodes.summary: Per-tool-function usage statistics: call/completion/failure counts, files touched, total duration.

nodes.name: FileChangeSummary
nodes.summary: Summary of file changes in a session: total files, breakdown by operation, and top-touched files.

nodes.name: FileOperationEntry
nodes.summary: Count and file list for a single file-operation category (e.g. reads, writes).

nodes.name: FileFrequencyEntry
nodes.summary: Touch count and operation list for a single file, used to rank most-active files.

nodes.name: ConversationStats
nodes.summary: Conversation-level stats: message counts, thinking-event count, character counts, average response time.

nodes.name: TokenStats
nodes.summary: Aggregated token usage: total input/output/total tokens broken down by model.

nodes.name: ModelTokenEntry
nodes.summary: Per-model token usage entry: input/output tokens and call count.

nodes.name: TimelineBucket
nodes.summary: A single time-bucketed activity slice: event/tool-call/message/error counts.

nodes.name: ErrorStats
nodes.summary: Aggregated error/failure statistics with a per-tool breakdown.

nodes.name: ToolErrorEntry
nodes.summary: Per-tool error and failure counts.

nodes.name: MultiSessionSummary
nodes.summary: Aggregated analytics summary across multiple sessions, including per-session entries.

nodes.name: SessionSummaryEntry
nodes.summary: Per-session summary entry within a multi-session analytics aggregation.

nodes.name: analytics.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers exposing session analytics computation (single, cached, and multi-session) to the frontend.

nodes.name: es_compute_analytics
nodes.summary: Tauri command that computes and returns SessionAnalytics for a session's currently loaded events.

nodes.name: es_compute_cached_session_analytics
nodes.summary: Tauri command that computes SessionAnalytics from cached (persisted) events for a session.

nodes.name: es_compute_multi_session_analytics
nodes.summary: Tauri command that computes aggregated analytics across a list of session ids.

nodes.name: batch_update.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for batch/targeted mutations of a session's event store: completing running tasks, patching/removing events by id, updating active-task args, and updating shell process state.

nodes.name: es_complete_last_running
nodes.summary: Tauri command that marks the last running task event in a session as complete.

nodes.name: es_patch_by_ids
nodes.summary: Tauri command that applies a JSON patch to a set of events identified by id.

nodes.name: es_remove_by_id_prefix
nodes.summary: Tauri command that removes events whose id starts with a given prefix.

nodes.name: es_remove_synthetic_user_inputs
nodes.summary: Tauri command that removes synthetic/placeholder user-input events from a session.

nodes.name: es_replace_and_remove
nodes.summary: Tauri command that replaces one event with a new event while removing another by id, in a single atomic update.

nodes.name: es_update_active_task_args
nodes.summary: Tauri command that merges additional arguments into the active (in-flight) tool-call event matching given function names.

nodes.name: es_update_last_shell_output
nodes.summary: Tauri command that appends streamed output to the most recent shell/process event.

nodes.name: es_update_last_shell_process
nodes.summary: Tauri command that updates the pid/status/exit-code/log-path of the most recent shell process event.

nodes.name: es_has_active_task
nodes.summary: Tauri command that checks whether a session currently has an active (in-flight) task matching given function names.
